The drawing shows a benzyl ether on a benzene ring, with iodine on the adjacent carbon and a Boc-protected N-methylaminoethyl chain para to the ether.

- **Left ring:** a phenyl group attached to a CH2, which is bonded to an O (the benzyloxy group).
- **Central ring:** the O sits on one ring carbon, and the iodine is on the next carbon (ortho to O). The CH2CH2 chain is on the carbon para to O, which is meta to I.
- **Side chain:** CH2CH2 leads to N, which carries a methyl (the bond drawn downward) and a Boc group.
- **Boc:** C(=O)OC(C)(C)C.

SMILES: CN(CCc1ccc(OCc2ccccc2)c(I)c1)C(=O)OC(C)(C)C

I checked this against the drawing atom for atom. No stereochemistry is shown, so none is included.
